description: Defines the SharedBuffer class for inter-process shared memory communication, including synchronization via semaphores, buffer management, and access control.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class facilitating shared memory buffer with synchronization for inter-process communication.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[])
methods.description: Consumer constructor, initializes shared buffer in consumer role.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[], const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const uint16_t administrationSize)
methods.description: Producer constructor, initializes shared buffer in producer role with specified mode and size.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Locks the producer semaphore to request permission to produce data.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Signals that data production is complete and releases the consumer semaphore.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Locks the consumer semaphore to request permission to consume data.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Signals that data has been consumed and releases the producer semaphore.

methods.name: AdministrationBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to the administration buffer.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Gets user permissions for the buffer.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Gets group permissions for the buffer.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Gets permission mode for the buffer.
